title: Pathfinder on the SPI bus
hints: Run it and open the Timeline. At tick 2, attitude waits while telemetry *formats* a packet, and that doesn't need the bus at all. Fix that first, then run again and look at tick 12: who is running while attitude waits?

Two changes: move `rtos_busy(3)` (the formatting) to before `rtos_mutex_lock`, so the lock only covers `spi_transfer(2)`. Then create the mutex with priority inheritance, so telemetry is boosted while attitude waits for it.
In telemetry: `rtos_busy(3); rtos_mutex_lock(spi_bus, RTOS_WAIT_FOREVER); spi_transfer(2); rtos_mutex_unlock(spi_bus);` and in `rover_start`: `spi_bus = rtos_mutex_create(true);`
